name: prorataai/gist-answers
description: Integrates Gist.ai with WordPress to sync publisher content, configure answer experiences, and display AI-powered Gist answer widgets on your site.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit and Playwright e2e suites (both need a WordPress environment; see README.md)
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the PHPUnit suite (needs WP_TESTS_DIR pointing at the WordPress test library)
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run the Playwright e2e suite against the site at E2E_URL
